q1: SELECT * FROM A AS X WHERE X.C IN (SELECT Y.C FROM A AS Y)
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT * FROM A AS X WHERE X.C IN (SELECT Y.C FROM A AS Y)
explanation: Q1 filters rows in table A where the column C exists in the same table, which effectively means it selects all rows since every value of C in A is compared with all other values of C in A. Q2, on the other hand, simply selects all rows from table A without any filtering.
counterexample_dsp: The difference is triggered when table A contains at least one row. Since Q1 filters based on the existence of C in the same table, it will always return all rows. Q2, however, returns all rows without any conditions.
